this is true in all aspects of life, including in the gym. 

to look at it in a gym sense, sticking with the same weight for the same amount of reps each week, over and over again, is going to get you absolutely no where. 

if you want to actually GROW, start picking up some heavier weight, start doing more reps, and start genuinely struggling in the gym.

Changing your life comes down to one key thing: MINDSET. The belief that you are capable of change, truly want to change, and are willing to work toward true change (and I mean ACTUALLY work, giving 100% of your best attitude and effort) are critical keys to creating change. ? 

These two photos show how life can change once you change your mindset. The before was taken about 4 months into my fitness journey, the after taken last week - almost 3 years later. 

In that time I’ve worked to never break my promises to myself, to show up for myself every day and to not make excuses, and I’ve accepted that this is a lifelong LIFESTYLE not a diet or a quick fix. 

The amount of health, happiness, and self love is almost unbelievable. It’s a whole new life. 

And, it all started by changing my MINDSET and betting on ME. ??

Within this warrior monastery exists the Infantry Officer Course or IOC.

Here, Marine Infantry Platoon Commanders are forged.

In the harsh and unforgiving terrain that surround it, they are sharpened and refined.

The master instructors serve one purpose and one purpose only, to prepare a product that is worthy of leading Marines. 

A no-fail mission.

You will not find warmth.

You will not find praise.

You will not find understanding.

Remember, we don’t have to strive for perfection, we just have to win the small margins. 

There’s still a philosophy in PB that eliminating all unforced errors wins matches. I totally disagree (once we step beyond 2.5-3.5 levels). If our primary goal is to never make an error, we’ll never take risks. If we never step out of comfort and risk, we’ll remain frozen in passivity and fear, forever being the reactor. 

Before the angry replies start, I’m not advocating recklessness. That’s not a winning strategy either. I am saying, though, that the only way to have zero unforced errors on the stat sheet at the end of the match is by being scared to miss. This is no way to play any sport!

The aggressive athlete wins. The passive athlete loses.
Period.

The trick is finding a way to implement aggression and risk-taking without losing your mind in kamikaze decisions. The great ones search for these puzzle pieces, unafraid of making mistakes along their path. They’re willing to adjust and adap

When Plan B works out just fine?

I had high hopes for this dresser when I got it because it is a vintage Kroehler. But it was in a very rough shape with broken off corners, wobbly leg and what not. 

It is sometimes hard to come up with a cohesive design with wood and paint that won’t look awkward. This one had so many hurdles- like the old hardware had to go, so that involved filling old holes and that called for paint, the rebuilt corners- same. 

That’s when I decided it is time to be at peace with the fact that this has to be entirely painted. Chose this dark olive to keep its vintage charm. Funny enough- I love the results! This was meant to be painted! 
Colour- Bayberry + Coal @fusionmineralpaint 

It got sold from sneak peeks, so I am sure it will be loved?

tentoonstellingstip: REMBRANDT | Fotograaf avant la lettre - Museum De Reede

Rembrandt wordt wereldwijd niet enkel geroemd als schilder, maar ook als meesterlijk tekenaar en etser. Doorheen zijn hele carrière ging Rembrandt aan de slag met de etsnaald, waarbij hij dezelfde brede waaier aan onderwerpen omarmde als in zijn schilderijen, zoals o.a. (zelf)portretten, landschappen, religieuze en mythologische thema’s.

De tentoonstelling Rembrandt – Fotograaf avant la lettre brengt deze onderwerpen samen in een selectie van een 80-tal werken en gaat op zoek naar de unieke blik op de realiteit door het oog deze wereldbekende kunstenaar: een bijna hedendaagse en fotografische kijk op de wereld in een tijdperk lang voor de uitvinding van de fotografie.

?The #1 mistake most runners make is not running their easy runs at a truly easy pace.  How can you tell what's easy?

Here are a few tips:

Your easy pace should be a pace where you can hold a conversation as easily as you could walking.

?You should be able to sing to your music or argue out loud with the podcast you are listening to.

?And my personal favorite, you should be able to close your mouth for several minutes and only nose breathe.

Some people specifically train themselves to nose breathe while running, but that's not what I'm talking about here.  This is just a simple test for a few minutes to keep yourself in check.

CALABAZA FRITA CON PATATAS.

Pelamos y partimos las patatas como si fueran para patatas al montón.

Pelamos la calabaza, retiramos las pepitas ( no se tiran , las podemos secar o cocer, están muy ricas y tienen muchas vitaminas) y la cortamos igual que la patata.

En una sartén ponemos abundante aceite de oliva y ponemos todo a freír, añadimos un pelín de sal.

Tapamos y a fuego medio vamos friendo.

Vamos dando vueltas y rompiendo la patata/calabaza con la cuchara o espumadera.

En los últimos minutos cuando ya más o menos estén, probamos y rectificamos de sal ( este plato debe tener un toque de dulzor que es el que le aporta la calabaza), subimos fuego y tostamos según nos guste.

Receta muy antigua de mi abuela pasada a mi madre, con productos que tenían de la huerta y  el aceite de oliva que tenían todo el año.

First, changing the room into a home office. Chances are you now work remote, so why not create a space of your own to optimize your productivity? 

Second, turning the space into a home gym! You don’t need a lot of equipment to have the perfect space to prioritize your health. Some free weights, yoga mats, and a stationary bike are easy to obtain and don’t take up a lot of space. You can even add a TV for workout videos!?

La planche (le gainage): êtes-vous sur.e que la vôtre soit alignée et efficace ?

3 points à retenir :
?Rétroversez légèrement le bassin pour bien engager les abdos et éviter de cambrer le dos (et d'avoir le bassin qui s'affaisse ou les fesses qui remontent trop).
? Protractez les omoplates (en les écartant dans le dos) pour engager votre grand dentelé et ne pas laisser le buste s'affaisser vers le sol. 
? Allongez la nuque, gardez les épaules au dessus des poignets et tendez les jambes en engageant les quadriceps.

? Bienfaits : cette posture renforce les triceps, les épaules, les abdos, augmente la concentration, améliore l'endurance et dynamise le corps.

? Contre indications : ne pas réaliser cette posture ou trouver des ajustements adaptés à votre corps, si vous avez une blessure aux poignets ou aux épaules (privilégiez la planche sur les avant-bras).

Bonne pratique ?

??Muscle growth occurs when muscle protein synthesis exceeds muscle protein breakdown. Resistance exercise stimulates both muscle protein synthesis and breakdown. Ingestion of protein further increases muscle protein synthesis and is needed to achieve a positive protein net balance.

?In young adults, 20 g of high-quality protein seems optimal to stimulate post-exercise muscle protein synthesis. However, is this also true for older adults?

?This study investigated muscle protein synthesis rates following ingestion of different protein dosages in older adults. All participants performed a bout of resistance exercise, followed by the ingestion of 0, 15, 30, or 45 g of milk protein.

First prototype of barbell jacks. Just used some rest materials. In theory, the barbell only needs to be supported in z-axis and x-axis direction, and only directly underneath the barbell slot. 1 prototype has some soft leater in the barbell slot to dampen the pressure to the side direction when only 1 barbell side is being loaded/unloaded. 

A quick test showed that the jack is able to support a single side load of 90 kg / 200lbs. One of the metal corner supports slightly bended due to previously mentioned pressure to rhe side. A load of 90 kg per side is waaaayyy beyond my current capabilities so this construction more than sufficient. Maybe a solid piece of wood will be needed to fortify the corner support and prevent any more bending. 

The jack has a round corner so it fits easily beneath a loaded barbell but the rounding increases in distance to raise the barbell.

Hi, I‘m Nina.
The harbour is my happy place and I love sunsets.

In den letzten Tagen musste ich mein eingerostetes Englisch ausgraben.
Wir hatten einen schwedischen Gast während der letzten drei Tage in der Firma und gestern Mittag stellte sich heraus das sie das erste Mal in Hamburg ist.
Bevor sie mir das erzählte hatte sie keine Pläne für den Abend, danach hatte ich einen für sie ?
Natürlich Sonnenuntergang am Hafen und eine Fahrt mit der Fähre in den selbigen ?
Die Sonnenuntergänge sind bei der kalten, klaren Luft gerade einfach nur magisch!

Bei solchen Gelegenheiten stelle ich immer wieder auf‘s Neue fest wie sehr ich Hamburg liebe und meine Begeisterung dafür gerne teile.

Tolerance is not the opposite of intolerance.

Enabling is the opposite of intolerance.

Tolerance promotes unity and respect. Within a tolerant environment everyone is valued and respected, regardless of their background, beliefs, or experiences. 

To have an environment in which everyone is respected there must be standards and expectations for how everyone behaves. Not allowing behaviors that impose negative consequences on others doesn’t make you intolerant. 

If you’re so afraid of being viewed as intolerant that you refuse to hold others accountable, then you end up becoming an enabler. 

You, the person engaging in the negative behavior, the people directly impacted, and the group collectively are all made worse by enabling.

This is often a hard balance to find. As a coach you must find it to effectively help others, especially if you coach groups and not just individuals.

Finding this balance begins with defining yourself by who you want to be and not just what you don’t want

Have you set goals for yourself? At the beginning of the year I set my goals as:

1. Workout at least 5 days a week
2. Take 100,000 steps a week
3. Close all of the circles on my Fitbit each day
4. Eat as clean as possible

Adding an extra 5,000 steps to my goal each day has really kept me active and has helped me close all of the rings on my Fitbit. It is also helping me burn more calories each day and keeping my weight in check. 

I have always been consistent with working out 5 days a week, but I signed up for Les Mills on Demand a couple of months ago and between the strength training and cardio workouts it is really helping me be the fittest version of myself. 

Setting goals and holding yourself accountable is important if you want to change your Jody. What are your health and fitness goals?

FYI: Last week I was on vacation and in a car a lot so I did not get my 100,000 steps or my 5 days of workouts.

Jordan Peterson believed that communication is a two-way process and that it's important for individuals to be able to effectively communicate their ideas and opinions. He believed that if someone is not listening to you, it's likely that your message is not being heard and is not making an impact. Peterson recommended that people stop talking and instead try to understand why their message is not being received. He believed that this could involve examining the way that the message is being presented, the context in which it's being delivered, or the individual's own communication skills. By taking a step back and evaluating the situation, individuals can then re-frame their message or approach in a way that is more likely to be heard and understood by the person they are trying to communicate with.

Save for later ??
____

- Arm splits on foam roller. Holding light weights for an extra stretch. 

- 90/90 flys 

- Superman swims 

- Overhead runners march. Sorry this was the best video I had. Not too heavy. Just heavy enough to apply downward pressure on the scapula. Push it into place and strengthen. 

- Up and over pulling band apart through the entire movement 

- Underhand reverse fly with band 

- Overhand reverse fly 

- Scorpion chest stretch 

- Overhead reverse lunge. Same idea as the runners march, except more of a leg workout

- Med ball roll - stretch, wiggle, roll, open the chest. spend some time and get loose. 
____

There is a MYTH in the running world that every marathoner needs to complete multiple 20 mile long runs or even one 20 mile long run to finish a marathon. Long run lengths are based on...?
.
? TOTAL WEEKLY VOLUME: Your long run should not be more than 33% of your total weekly volume! If your long run is 50% of your total weekly volume, it's going to take you that much longer to recover from it. You likely will not be able to do quality workouts during the week if you are running 50% of your weekly volume in one run! Long runs are HARD on our bodies and we need to respect the recovery that comes along with them
.
? 3 HOUR RULE: We like to cap long runs at 3 hours max! Research has shown that your body gets the most physiological aerobic benefits from runs between 60-90 min in duration AND that runs over 3 hours start to have diminishing returns. The risk for injury becomes much higher! This

3 More Reps! (1978)

I recently acquired the difficult to find Books 1, 2, and 3 of 3 More Reps! 

Olympus Gym in Warrington, PA published Book 1 of the series in 1978, Book 2 in 1979, and Book 3 in 1980. The books  provide an overview of the workouts of top bodybuilders of the period, largely based from the clinics they presented there. Book 1 includes the clinics of Arnold Schwarzenegger, Frank Zane, Ed Corney, Franco Columbu Mike Mentzer, and Robby Robinson. 

All three Books of 3 More Reps! were written by Olympus Gym owner George Snyder and bodybuilder and writer Rick Wayne (Both pictured on back cover).

The bodybuilder I purchased the set from attended some of the clinics in the 1970s and even included an autograph of Robby Robinson from 1979 and a few original flyers. I’ve been wanting this collection for some time, and I’m stoked that I got it from someone who was there at the time.

From 2008-2015 pretty much every Wednesday at lunchtime this was the workout at the HMP I worked at. It’s also the workout I was doing in a gym in Chelmsford were I meet my best pal for the first time and he was was doing front squats into Heavy KB Swings into Foam Roller. Two crazy bastards together. 

WOD
HMP
(Once you put 2 hands on the bar you can not let go till you have completed that round)

1 Squat Thrust + 1 Bent Over Row + 1 Squat Thrust + 1 Deadlift + 1 Squat Thrust + 1 Hang Clean (1 round)

Increase in acceding numbers till:

10 Squat Thrust + 10 Bent Over Row + 10 Squat Thrust + 10 Deadlift + 10 Squat Thrust + 10 Hang Clean

Hope this serves as a reminder to you:
Learn to appreciate your body for all the ways it shows up for you, not only for what it looks like.

What’s going on guys. Here are 5 banded core exercises that will improve you core stability, core strength, core control and optimize your performance 
-
Adding a weight through the band really gives you that extra work of stability so you can really contract your core and stabilize it. The goal isn’t to go heavy with the weight but add something light that will move the band for you and force you to really squeeze and stabilize your core 
-
These exercises are great for anyone especially those looking to get stronger and improve their performance. As you can tell, I was burning with them. Really focus on be explosive with the push and squeeze. The moment you let of your core, you’ll break form and start swaying
-
Perform each exercise for 4 sets of 10 reps per side. You can do it all as one workout or add a few into your routine

In my experience, people drastically overestimate their ability to focus on more than one thing at a time. Several years ago a string of books came out about habits that backed that up with science. I know in my life if I try to make too many changes all at once they all fail. 

It's been far more effective to focus on a single item, make it a habit, and then add another when the first no longer requires much effort.

As we come to New Years resolution time, consider picking one thing instead of 5 or 10 or 100. Pick one thing this year and succeed.

Speaking about productivity and it’s miss-consumptions:??

??Productivity is often seen as something which means the same for all which can often make us feel unproductive and less motivated when comparing our own productivity to someone’s else’s.

??Throughout this week I’ve managed to fit in daily morning gym sessions to prioritise uni work throughout the day which was productive in the moment. However, now it’s come to Friday, I was feeling extra tired therefore sleeping in this morning was in turn more productive than getting up early again despite looking like more of a slacking day.

??This always correlates into fitness when regarding injury and external plans we all face in life, for example, missing a leg day when your experiencing a small injury is more productive than training on it in the long run.

??Therefore, at whatever stage of your fitness journey and life in general it is impossible to compare productivity from one person to another as we all have different versions

Ich laufe seit Jahren mit Bone Conduction Kopfhörern von @shokzde und darf einen Open Run Pro an euch, meine liebste Lauf-Community, verlosen! Ich liebe diese Kopfhörer so sehr! Man hört die Umgebung, er ist super leicht und sieht extrem nice aus. Ich will nicht mehr drauf verzichten, vor allem weil ich ja so viel Podcast beim Laufen höre und da brauch ich gute Kopfhörer. Anzeige | Der neue OpenRun Pro von @shokzde ist da ?

Und jetzt noch mein Versprechen die brandneuen Premium Sportkopfhörer Shokz OpenRun Pro kurz vorzustellen. Dazu gibt es ein kurzes erstes Fazit zu der Neuheit ?

??? ??? ???? ??????? ??? ????
?? Der OpenRun Pro hat eine längere Akkulaufzeit. Ihr könnt 10 Stunden lang Musik hören & Anrufe entgegennehmen. Damit ist die Akkulaufzeit sogar 2 Stunden länger als bei den Modellen Aeropex und OpenRun.
?? Wie der OpenRun verfügt auch der OpenRun Pro eine vorteilhafte Schnellladefunktion. Beim OpenRun Pro ist die Schnelladefunktion doppelt so schnell. Ihr braucht nur eine 5-minütige Ladezeit für eine Akkulaufzeit von 1,5 Stunden, sofern der Akku zum Ladebeginn entladen ist. Schon in innerhalb einer Stunde sind die neuen Premium Sportkopfhörer komplett aufgeladen.
?? Mit dem neuen Modell habt Ihr durch die neue Shokz TurboPitch™-Technologie eine noch bessere Soundqualität. Die verbesserte Qualität macht sich besonders bei tieferen Basstönen be

[Anzeige/Gewinnspiel] ?
Manchmal hilft nur eins: Laufschuhe an, Musik auf die Ohren und los. Und genau deshalb haben wir heute ein kleines Gewinnspiel für euch: Wir verlosen 1 x die nagelneuen Openrun Pro Kopfhörer von @shokzde (ehemals Aftershokz), die für den Sport entwickelt worden sind. ????? 

Für alle, die beim Laufen gerne die Umgebungsgeräsuche wahrnehmen oder Probleme mit In-Ear-Kopfhörern haben, sind die Openrun Pro genau das Richtige. ?? Denn hier wird auf die sogenannte «Bone Conduction» gesetzt, d.h. die Ohren sind frei und nicht verdeckt oder „verstopft“, da die Kopfhörer vor dem Ohr auf dem Kieferknochen anliegen und die Musik somit über Schall ins Ohr weitergeleitet wird. ?? Ziemlich nice Technologie! ?

Außerdem gibt’s ein paar Neuerungen bei den Oprenrun Pro:
? Es sind ein paar Farben dazu gekommen: Blau, Rosa, Beige (trägt Susi auf den Fotos) und Schwarz
? Bass, Bass, wir brauchen Bass! Dieser hat sich verbessert (durch Shokz TurboPitch Technologie)
? Wie oben schon

GIVEAWAY TIME ???? @shokz_benelux (voorheen Aftershokz) heeft sinds enkele weken de OpenRun Pro gelanceerd waar ik tijdens mijn duurloopjes al even kennis mee mocht maken??????. En nu mag ik één van mijn volgers ook blij maken met deze nieuwste generatie bone conductie?? . Met een batterijduur van 10 uur en een snellaad functie waarmee je na 5 minuten snelladen alweer 1,5 uur kunt trainen is de OpenRun Pro ideaal voor duursporters. Ben jij een duursporter en zou je ook graag kennis maken met de OpenRun Pro? Zorg dat je mij en @shokz_benelux volgt en laat een comment achter met waarom je hem graag wilt winnen en in welke kleur (zwart, blauw, beige of roze). Bijvoorbeeld door te laten weten waarvoor je traint of misschien wel waarom je hem juist aan een trainingsmaatje of vriend gunt. Meedoen kan tot en met 14 maart. Daarna ontvangt de winnaar persoonlijk bericht.
